_comment: Every global gameplay number. Source: design doc 'Starting numbers' tab (2026-10-22) unless marked 'placeholder'. All first drafts: tune in playtests.

player._stamina: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.6 (ER): 45/s after 0.5 s (Raven's first draft was 30/s after 0.8 s). Paused while guarding, sprinting and from an attack's press until its cancel window opens.
player._wake: respawnSeconds: the wait before the death screen's Wake button works. autoWakeSeconds > 0: wake at your pick after that long without pressing it (0: wait for you).
player._movement: FULL-GAME 9: 0.15 s to full speed (maxAcceleration cm/s/s), a quick stop (brakingDeceleration, brakingFriction with separate braking friction on), groundFriction for turns.
player._poise: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.5: a player's poise comes from armour (items.json equip.poise) and nodes (Tempered); poise damage adds up and resets to full poiseResetSeconds after the last poise hit, and at once after a reaction (ER).

beds._comment: Beds and bedrolls (WRBeds): a bed you just woke at rests restSeconds before you can wake there again; a bedroll is used up when you wake on it (bedrollSingleUse 1). placeholder
beds._hearth: Every unbroken Hearth of yours or your clan's is a place to wake (cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.6): you stand up hearthWakeRingCm from it, facing the fire; after you wake there it rests hearthRestSeconds for you.

chat._comment: Chat channels (cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.3, AWRPlayerController::ServerChat): /g everyone, /l nearby (within localRangeCm), /c your clan, /w name a whisper, /r a reply. At most perSecond lines a second per player, burst at once; maxLength characters; history lines kept (the HUD shows the last 6 for 25 s). colors: each channel's lines (sRGB hex).

door._comment: Hinged doors and gates (cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.1, AWRBuildPiece::OnRep_Door / Tick): the leaf turns about its hinge to openDeg over swingSeconds (gates gateSwingSeconds: a heavier leaf), away from whoever opens it; open it eases out past the stop by openBounceDeg and settles back; shut it eases into the frame and rebounds latchBounceDeg over latchBounceSeconds as the latch drops. Refused while a body stands in the swing.

stamina._stamina: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.6: roll 12 at every load, backstep 8, jump 8. Melee costs come from Data/weapons.json moves. graceFloor: an action starts with any stamina left and may take it this far below zero (ER's last swing); nothing starts while it's below zero. A refused press flashes the stamina bar for refuseFlashSeconds and shakes it refuseShake px. A blocked hit costs the blow's staminaDamage x (1 - guard boost / 100) (weapons.json guard / offhands).

weapon._riposte: Crits (ripostes, backstabs, stance-break crits) use the weapon class's crit multipliers in Data/weapons.json; light/heavy timing and stamina for weapons with a class are its moves there.

defense._comment: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.2, 1.3, 1.7 (cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.3-3.4). load: the roll by equip load (worn + held kg / (maxEquipLoad + the equipLoad stat)): light below lightBelow, medium below mediumBelow, heavy below 1, overloaded at or over it (a slow step, no i-frames); distance cm covered over travel s, i-frames from iStart to iEnd s, the roll ends at max(travel, iEnd) + recovery. backstep: Dodge with the stick at rest. jumpLegInvuln: s after take-off that blows flagged low (ground waves, tail sweeps, stomps) pass under. Guard: blockStun s after a blocked light (impact <= 2) / heavy blow, then guardCounterWindow s in which Heavy is the guard counter; parryTapSeconds: letting go of Guard sooner is a committed parry (its recovery plays); a press within parrySpamWindow s of the last shrinks the parry window by parrySpamShrink. perfectDodgeSeconds: a blow the roll's i-frames take this soon after it starts is a perfect dodge (Event.PerfectDodge: Frozen moment). ledgeDrop: a roll stops at an edge with more than this drop unless the stick still holds toward it (ledgeStickDot). creature/bossStaminaDamage: what a blocked creature or boss blow costs (x its damage) before the guard boost.

combat._full: Full attack set (cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.2-2.4): charge (Heavy held: min s to count, full s for the charged row's whole damage, max s it lets go by itself), contextWindow s after a roll / backstep for the rolling / backstep light, runAttackSpeed cm/s for a running attack, jumpAttack (maxAir s the blade stays live in the air, landGrace s after landing, heavyRadius x its sweep), counterHit (on a body winding up: damage, pierceDamage, stance), stealth (an unaware target: stance, buildup), twoHand (a 1h weapon held in both: damage, lightStance, heavyStance), minArtWindup / minHeavyCoil (the coil rule).
combat._blade: cooks/cookpass-combat.md 3.1-3.2. blade: a survivor's swing cuts with the drawn weapon's real path from its clip (weapons.json blade); stepCm = the most the tip moves between two tests. recoil: a chain light (not a thrust) whose blade meets a wall (a surface with |normal.z| under wallNormalZ) in the first activeShare of its strike, before touching a body, clanks off: the swing stops, the hero is held seconds.
combat._comment: Feel and commitment (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.16, L2; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.2). bufferSeconds: a press that can't start yet waits this long (the last press wins); a dodge pressed mid-swing waits up to dodgeBufferMax for the cancel window. comboFraction: the last part of a swing's recovery in which the next chain attack starts; cancelFraction: from this share of the recovery a roll or guard cuts the swing (lights / heavies). chainGrace: s after a swing ends in which a light still continues its chain. stepIn: the lock target (else the nearest enemy within range cm and cone degrees) pulls the swing in toward ideal x reach off its body, min..max cm (shorter steps are skipped), over stepFraction of the wind-up. lightMoveMultiplier: the legs keep walking at this speed while a light swings (heavies root you). clipWarp: the swing clip is timed so its contact frames land on the active window: the coil plays at most maxCoilRate (a longer lead-in starts later), below minRate it holds the first frame instead of crawling, the strike plays between activeMin and activeMax x. windowsFromClips 1 lets the clips' own notifies set the windows (0: the move rows do, the same on every machine and the server).

crit._comment: Critical attacks (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.3, 1.4; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.4). Light on a target whose stance is broken (or a guard-broken player) from its front (frontArc degrees, within stanceCritRange cm of its body; big = radius over bigRadius) is a riposte; from behind (backstabArc, PvP pvpBackstabArc) within backstabRange of a body no bigger than backstabMaxRadius / backstabMaxHalfHeight that isn't winding up, a backstab (big ones only while broken). The attacker warps to syncDistance cm off its body over warpSeconds, is invulnerable until the damage frame (ripostePaired / backstabPaired damageAt of total s), and the target is held until damageAt + holdAfter. parryOpenSeconds: how long a parry that breaks leaves it open; parryInterruptSeconds: the stagger of one that doesn't. exposed: a parried creature takes exposedDamage x from everyone for exposedSeconds (Valheim). guardBrokenRiposte: s a guard-broken player can be riposted. pvpDamage x on players, riseIFrames for the victim after.

stance._parts: Breakable parts and head strikes (combat.md 2.10): a strike within headRadius cm of the head lock point x headStrikeMult stance; a blow within partRadius cm of a part takes its stance too; broken: partStaggerSeconds stagger and partBreakBodyStance of the body's stance.
stance._comment: Creature and boss stance (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.4): a hidden meter by tier (creatures.json stance overrides); hits take it down by their stance damage (weapons.json moves; spells and creatures' own blows by damage x spellPerDamage / creaturePerDamage; a shatter x shatterMult). It starts refilling max / regenDelayDivisor s after the last stance hit, at regenPerSecond (x lowHealthRegen below half health, Sekiro). At zero it breaks for breakSeconds by tier: the crit opens. Bosses take stance damage x group.<participants> (4 or more: group.4; tames count). Parries: parriesToBreak by kind; a parry that doesn't break takes nonBreakParryStance of max. slump: the broken body's head drops pitch degrees and it sinks by sink x its half height over seconds.

poise._comment: Poise (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.5; combat.md 2.5). A player whose poise breaks reacts by the blow's impact (1 flinch, 2 stagger, 3+ heavy stagger: s locked); a blow that doesn't break it is a shudder. Creatures flinch for creatureFlinchSeconds unless they're attacking with hyperarmor (creatures.json hyperarmor, bosses). The hyperarmor window of a heavy (wind-up to the end of its strike) multiplies poise by hyperarmor.heavy and takes hyperarmorDamageTaken less damage.

net._comment: Server rewind (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.17; cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.4): every character's body is kept for history s at sampleHz. A player's swing and crit are judged against bodies where that player saw them (its ping / 2 + interpSeconds, at most rewindMax). A creature's or boss's blow on a remote player waits up to its ping + interp (at most rewindMax) for the defence it pressed when it saw the blow.
net._players: How many can be in a world at once (WRAccess; cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.4): a listen world's host sets listenMinPlayers..listenMaxPlayers on the Hosting page (listenDefaultPlayers until then), a dedicated server up to dedicatedMaxPlayers (dedicatedDefaultPlayers until its access.json says).
net._scale: 100 players on a server (cooks/build-wild-100players.md). graph: the Replication Graph (WRNetGraph): mode dedicated (dedicated servers only; the default), always, off (-wrrepgraph=on|off on the server's command line wins); cellM its grid cells; biasM how far from the origin the grid starts; peopleNearM other players' states every frame when their body is this near you, else each one every farPeopleSeconds. classes: per-class budgets (WRNet; a row matches the class and its subclasses, the nearest wins; a field left out, or a value the instance set in code, is kept): hz NetUpdateFrequency, minHz, cullM net cull distance, priority, doze = dormant between changes (the watcher looks at each one every doze.checkSeconds, at most doze.perFrame a frame, and wakes it when a replicated field changed). creatureIdleHz: a creature standing still with no target, not hit for creatureIdleAfterHitSeconds. fxHearM: server effects go to the players this near. arrivalsToAllUpTo: 'X is back / left' goes to everyone up to this many players, above it to their clan and the admins. queue: a full world's waiting line (WRAccess): holdSeconds a slot is held for a joiner while they load in, staleSeconds a waiting place is kept between tries, retrySeconds how often the joiner's game tries, maxWaiting the longest line, adminSlots how many admins may come in past the cap. save: playerEverySeconds each player's autosave (spread round robin), piecesPerFrame the sliced world save.

claims._comment: Land claims (cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.7): totems stand at least two full-upgrade radii plus gapCm apart (claims never nest or grow into a neighbour); a claim's name is up to nameLength letters.

access._comment: Who may come into a world (WRAccess, access.json; cooks/cookpass-multiplayer.md 3.4): passwordTries wrong passwords from one address within passwordWindowSeconds lock it out until the window passes; hostCloseDelay: seconds between telling everyone the host is closing the world and closing it; the players list's ping colours (good under pingGoodMs, fair under pingFairMs).

paths._xp_per_use: placeholder: 60,500 XP per path ~ 80 h at 1x

momentum._comment: The Wind path's Momentum (cooks/biome-sky.md 2.18.2, WRWindPath.cpp): a spender that builds while you're airborne (jumping, falling, gliding, lifted, hovering) airborne a second, or sprinting faster than sprintSpeed cm/s sprint a second, + airHit a blow landed in the air; after decayDelay s without a gain it drains decayPerSecond. max + capacityPerRank a rank of Momentum capacity (nodeEffects wind.momentum_capacity maxMomentum). At highAt and over: knockback x knockbackAtHigh, stamina regen + staminaRegenAtHigh, and in a fight (a blow dealt or taken within fightSeconds) the body's spirals drift faster. No dead button: a Wind ability short of its Momentum goes off at halfEffect for its stamina alone.

growth._comment: The Nature path's Growth (cooks/biome-forest.md 2.17, WRNaturePath.cpp): a spender. max (+ nodeEffects nature.growth_capacity maxGrowth a rank); regrows by the ground within sampleRadius cm, read every sampleSeconds: lush / normal / barren a second (x Sap's growthRegen), in and out of combat; startFull 1: you wake with a full bar; offeringStone: a Grovekin offering stone's gift.

resources._charge: The Lightning path's Charge (cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.18.2): a builder; every lightning hit you land adds chargePerHit, it drains chargeDecayPerSecond after chargeDecayDelay s without a gain; at chargeHighAt and over: + chargeDamageBonusAtHigh lightning damage and + chargeMoveBonusAtHigh move speed.
resources._all: placeholder: doc defines behaviour only (Heat builds, boosts damage, stops at full; Chill fills slowly, spending it all makes bigger shatters)

status._full: Every status (cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.9, combat.md 2.11): a meter fills per hit and procs at the threshold (thresholds by tier; players 100 + worn resist), x procGrowth after each proc until resetAfterCombat s without a blow; bosses x bossParticipantResist per extra participant. infusedBuildup: what an infused weapon's light / heavy / charged blow builds. defs: each status's colour (sRGB hex, on the bars) and proc numbers.

entangled._comment: Entangled (the Nature status, WRNaturePath.cpp): roots hold the feet (Status.Rooted: no move, roll or jump; turning, attacks and casts work) for the tier's seconds (a caller may set its own); players player s at most (the PvP block); mini and major bosses are never held: slow bossSlow for bossSlowSeconds instead (the Hornwarden excepted); immune for immunity s after.

spores._comment: The Spore path's Spores (cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.17, WRSporePath.cpp): a spender bar. max (+ nodeEffects spore.spore_capacity maxSpores a rank); regen a second, x cloudRegen standing in any spore cloud; + gain for every planted Spore you detonate (spells.detonate.gain). Planted Spores: plantSeconds each (refreshed by a new plant), maxPlanted a target (+1 a capacity rank), playerMax on players; pvpDetonate: detonation damage on players x.

sporePath._comment: The Spore path's passives (WRSporePath.cpp). corrode: a rotting target's physical resist down (x damage; bosses corrodeBoss); lingering: rot seconds x (1 + rotDuration a rank); burst: rot on every other enemy within burstRadius of a detonated Spore; pandemic: every pandemicEvery s each rotting enemy within pandemicReach of you passes rot (half its time left; bosses x pandemicBoss) to every non-rotting enemy within pandemicJump; swarmMax sporelings at most; host: a kill on an enemy with your Spores spawns a free sporeling for hostSeconds; hiveMind: sporelings switch to your target within 0.5 s, +hiveDamage to it; regrowthAt: the bar at or over this for Regrowth spores; toxicBlood: Spores planted and poison on a melee attacker; adrenal: stamina a detonated Spore (max adrenalMax a detonation); pathMagic: the Sporestalker's calm (hold seconds, points, Spores, reach, below health).

nodeEffects._comment: Per-rank effect of each stat node (path.node -> stat -> amount per rank). Placeholders; ability nodes are separate abilities. blastRadius: fire area spells, Explosive bolt and Overheat reach further (x 1 + it). slowStrength: Slowed from your frost goes that much deeper (x 1 - it). areaRadius: frost area spells (Frost nova, Ice wall spacing, Blizzard) grow by it.

spells._sun: The Sun & sand path's spells (WRAbilitiesSun.cpp; cooks/biome-desert.md 2.17): radianceCost each; combat's KEPT numbers. Sandstorm and Desert's wrath ride on you; Shifting sands +15% radius a rank, Scour +4 a second a rank.
spells._tide: The Tide path (WRAbilitiesTide.cpp; cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.17, combat.md 2.13). flowCost: what each takes (short of it: refused, the bar flashes). Distances cm, times s, damage per hit or per second (dps).
spells._wind: The Wind path (WRAbilitiesWind.cpp; cooks/biome-sky.md 2.18.3, combat.md 2.12-2.13). momentumCost: what each takes (short of it: half effect). Distances cm, times s.

windGlide._comment: Path Glide (node wind_glide): glide with no glider; forward / sink cm/s; momentumPerSecond, then staminaPerSecond once Momentum is empty; free in an updraft column (WRSkyAir asks WRWind::PathGlideTick).

spells._shapes: Spell shapes (combat.md 2.13): wind-up and recovery s; roots 1 = you stand to cast (walls, novas, Meteor, Blizzard), 0 = you walk at half speed (bolts, lances, pools). A spell with chargeable 1 charges while its key is held: x chargeDamage at chargeMax s.
spells._lock: With a target locked on, bolts aim ahead of where it's going (lockLead 0 = at where it is), then curve toward it: cm/s/s, less against other players so they can dodge. A target past lockRange cm isn't aimed at.
spells._lightning: The Lightning path (cooks/biome-lightning.md 2.18.3, combat.md 2.12-2.13; WRAbilitiesLightning.cpp): charge = Charge gained on the cast; shockBuildup per hit; lockHomingPlayers 0 = a Spark never curves at a player. Chain lightning: the first target within range cm inside cone degrees of the aim, then jumps (+ Arc ranks) to the nearest unhit enemy within jumpRadius, x jumpDamage each. Thunderclap: stance x spell stance. Bolt dash / Lightning step: distance cm over spells.shapes.dash.travel s through enemies within width cm of the line, chargeCost spent (Lightning step: only the first of dashes within window s). Tempest: a strike on a random enemy inside radius every s (tell s ground glow, strikeRadius cm). Thunder god: seconds; each weapon hit calls a bolt (damage, shock, tell, radius).
spells._blood: Blood & curse (WRAbilitiesBlood.cpp, cooks/biome-swamp.md 2.17): every cost is HP (hpCost, through UWRBloodPath::SpendBlood into the Spilled bar). Bolts home only on creatures (lockHomingPlayers 0). bloodSpear pierces pierce bodies along range, width cm each side. bloodBoil: every enemy within radius with bleed buildup >= meterShare of its threshold or bleeding (bleedingSeconds) takes burstShare of its bleed burst. transfusion: hpCost from you, heal to an ally within range over seconds. crimsonTide: a wall width cm across travelling length cm at speed cm/s. doom: the mark bursts after delay s for base + takenShare x what the target took meanwhile (bosses x bossScale, cursed x cursedScale). sanguineLord: share of all damage you deal heals you for seconds.
spells._void: The Void path (biome-void 2.17): maxHp = max health the ability costs once the Void bar is at or past your tolerance (into MaxHealthLost); gain = Void it adds (Consume takes 20 off). Black hole / Collapse pull; Maw of the void's cone eats lowland and midland foes under eatBelow outright.
spells._necromancy: Necromancy (WRAbilitiesNecro.cpp, WRNecroPath.cpp, cooks/biome-graveyard.md 2.17): every cost is Souls (soulCost, free in Lich form); damage, decay / curse buildup, speed (cm/s), ranges (cm), cooldown (s).
spells._arcane: Arcane (WRAbilitiesArcane.cpp, WRArcanePath.cpp, cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.17): every cost is Mana (manaCost); damage, mark buildup, poise, ranges / radii (cm), seconds, cooldown (s). windup / recovery / roots override the shape's. arcaneBlast is chargeable (x1.5 at spells.chargeMax). barrier: shield HP (x Hardened ward), allyRange / allyCone for Ward allies. runeTrap: max runes, its burst's mark. starfall: stars over radius, each starRadius, glint s before it lands, spread s over which they fall. runeCircle: markPerSecond on enemies inside.
spells._nature: Nature (WRAbilitiesNature.cpp, WRPlantSummon.cpp, cooks/biome-forest.md 2.17): every cost is Growth (growthCost, given back when the cast finds nothing to do). thornShot flies straight at speed (never homing). regrowth: heal over seconds on the ally nearest the crosshair in cone within range (yourself with none). sanctuary / rootSnare: a pool at the aimed ground within range; rootSnare holds hold s (bosses slow bossSlow for bossSlowSeconds). stranglingVines: the lock or the enemy nearest the crosshair: held seconds at dps; a major boss isn't held: dps, bossStance a second, slow bossSlow. Plants (planted within plantRange): health (x Deep roots), seconds (x Fertile), growSeconds; sproutTurret spits shotsPerSecond thorns of thornDamage + thornBleed at thornSpeed at the nearest enemy within targetRange in sight; worldTree (height cm) heals healPerSecond within radius and takes damageTaken off what allies there take; ancientGuardian walks at walkSpeed after its planter's enemies within leash / seekRange (else keeps followDistance), slams every slamEvery s (slamWindup, slamRecovery) for slamDamage / slamPoise / slamStance in slamRadius, slamReach in front; on arrival it draws creatures within aggroRadius.

fx._comment: Combat feel and effect budgets (WRFx; the effects themselves are recipes in Data/fx.json). Client-side only. hitStop: how long the struck body's animation freezes on every blow by its tier (and the wielder's, for a melee blow only: a shot or spell never stops its shooter), never past 0.3 s from its start however many blows extend it, seconds. shake.<moment>: camera trauma 0..1 added (radius > 0: fades with distance from the camera, for slams and spells), scale = master (0 turns shaking off), maxAngle degrees / maxOffset cm at full trauma, decay per second, frequency of the wobble. impact.heavyScale = how much bigger a heavy blow's sparks/blood are, elementScale = the fire/frost burst on an infused or path melee hit. hud: hit marker and parry flash (seconds, alpha). Budgets: sprites per batch, pooled lights, distances (cm) for one-shots, drawing and lights. ambient/lava/weather: fires on Hearths and torches, statuses, lava embers, snow and ash (ridge distances from x = 0, cm).
fx._hitStack: COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L1 (cooks/build-combat-core.md 3.2): hitStop s by tier (both bodies' animation creeps at creep x, then catches up over catchUp s; it starts deepFraction of the strike after contact, at most deepMax s later, so it freezes at the blade's deepest point); weight by tier drives the camera (trauma base + scale x w^2, then squared again by the camera (Eiserloh): light 0.21 = 0.11 degrees, heavy 0.33 = 0.27, crit 0.62 = 0.96 (cookpass-combat 3.8) for the people in it, an FOV punch of base + scale x w degrees easing out over seconds), the pad (base + scale x w ms at strength x w; lights only the small motor) and the victim's shake (min..max cm at hz: the body, not the camera); flash: the victim's flash s by tier (parries gold) at opacity.

hud._hurt: cookpass-combat 3.7: the dark-red edge on the side a blow on you came from: strength hurtBase + hurtScale x its share of your max health (at most hurtMax), a tick hurtTick on every edge; fades over hurtSeconds; reaches hurtDepth of the screen in. tallySeconds: your running damage on a boss or an enemy bar stays this long after your last blow (3.3).

creature._biteTrack: during a bite's wind-up the creature stands still and turns toward its target at biteTrackRate deg/s for the first biteTrackFraction of the wind-up, then commits (a late step aside makes it miss)

wind._comment: The Wind path's passives (WRWindPath.cpp, WRAbilitiesWind.cpp). featherfallGliderStamina: Featherfall's glider stamina x. hopRank: the rank that adds the second jump, hopHeight cm. eyeOfTheStorm: damage taken x while spinning. drawFloor: Swift draw never takes a shot below this share. tailwind*: Tailwind shot's step back (cm, s). debris*: Debris stones (speed cm/s, never over 1,400; damage; gravity x; pitch deg). gale*: Lingering gale (radius cm, seconds, dps, push cm/s). look*: the fight look at high Momentum (drift x, +nits, hair stir / Hz / lift).

passives._lightning: The Lightning path's passives (WRLightningPath.cpp): Conductive (soaked bodies take + conductiveBonus lightning damage); Afterimage (a dodge's spark bursts afterimageDelay s later, afterimageRadius cm, damage, shock; one per afterimageCooldown s); Rapid fire (at Charge >= rapidFireAt: light / heavy swings x rapidFireAnimRate faster, spell cooldowns x rapidFireCooldownMult); Discharge (a block: radius cm, damage, shock, once per dischargeCooldown s, x dischargeParryMult on a parry); Grounded (storm strikes x groundedStrikeMult); Overcharge counts at Charge >= overchargeAt; Shock chance adds shockChanceBuildup; every move-speed source together caps at + moveSpeedCap.
passives._nature: The Nature path's passives (WRNaturePath.cpp): Rooted (main path) heals rootedHealPct of max health a second after rootedDelay s with no move input (slower than rootedStillSpeed cm/s counts as still), x rootedBarrenMult on barren ground, a creak every rootedCreakEvery s, the bark tinted toward rootedTint by share while it heals; Thorned skin returns thornedSkinDamage + thornedSkinBleed to a melee attacker (x thornedSkinPvp between players); Pollen slows enemies within pollenRadius of your plants (pollenSlow, bosses pollenBossSlow); Purify takes purifyPoison / purifyRot buildup off per heal tick; Overgrowth: overgrowthTurrets turrets at once; natureRefuseFlash: how long the Growth gauge flashes when a press is refused (s).

desert._comment: The Desert (WRDesertHazards; cooks/biome-desert.md 2.8). belt: run / easedRun (a veil, Dune oil or Dunewrap 4), vision / veilVision cm (the sky's sand fog), scarabReach (a tame Scarab digger brings the compass back). softSand: run (halved by the same), sprintStamina x. quicksand: tell s (the suck), sinkSeconds, dodgeLift (share a dodge lifts), walkOut (below this share you can wade out), drownSeconds at full, depth cm the body shows, pullReach / pullSeconds (an ally), outGrace. brine: tell, damage a second, climbSeconds, drop cm, brokenSeconds, run. slipface: tell, carry cm over carrySeconds, buriedSeconds, damage, stamina, buryDepth, popReach / popSeconds (a Dunejaw surfaces), cooldown. devils: radius, speed cm/s, liftSeconds, lift, throw, damage, blind, again. flood: delay s after rain in the peaks, stagger, speed, height (a ledge above this is dry), frontDepth, damage, carry, carrySeconds, debris. jar: wetRadius, wetSeconds, radius, damage, soak. flash: fuse, radius, facing degrees, blind. quest: wallReach, runbackReach, noonHalfHours. sky: hazeColor, hazeDensity, dustColor, beltDensityScale.

fungal._comment: The Fungal caverns' hazards (WRFungalHazards, cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.8-2.9). cloud: poison buildup a second inside after grace s (the motes gather first), rot too after rotAfter s without a breakSeconds break; windPush / strongPush cm; pushSeconds (eased), maxDrift (a place's cloud stays in its hall), homeAfter s; flashTell s, flashDamage + flashBurn, flashGoneHours (game hours); settleSeconds of snow then gone an hour; fireCatch s a flame is in it before it takes; wadMult (the spore wad). lines: tell s (the twang), stick s, reelUp cm over reelSeconds, touch cm, cutRadius / burnRadius / windTear cm, regrowHours, maxPerSet, cull. springcap: launch / pop cm up, aimDeg, popAfter s, autoFromHeight cm, throwSideways cm, regrow s. capFall: tell s (the dust shaft), knockLead s (the knocking before it), idolExtra s, noiseRadius cm, radius, damage, fallSeconds, regrowHours, moleWarn s. foulAir: move (just under 1: no sprint), staminaRegen, damageAfter s, dps. vent: every / sporefallEvery s, seconds, tell, width / height cm. bloom (underground every s for seconds, tell s before, spread x, beat). drift (Spore drift weather): every s, radius, seconds, distance cm, windYaw. gate: burnSeconds, openHours. moleDig s, fifthHits, heartGateSeconds. sporePot / galeFlask radius cm. glowPaste light.

creatureAI._comment: Wild creature behaviour. Hunting: carnivores get hungry every huntIntervalMinutes (x0.75-1.25), hunt the nearest wild non-carnivore up to preySizeRatio x their own radius (pack hunters packPreySizeRatio), eat a kill for eatSeconds (every hunter on it within shareKillRadius shares it), retry huntRetrySeconds after prey gets away; prey notice a hunter within preyNoticeRadius and bolt in bursts (preyRestSeconds between runs); a hunter in pursuit runs at huntSpeedMult and follows prey up to huntLeash cm from home. Morale: flee below fleeHealth, or below packFleeHealth when a packmate died in the last packLossSeconds, for fleeSeconds at fleeSpeedMult. Sleep: aggro x sleepAggroMult asleep, x nightAggroMult for night hunters at night; a hit keeps it awake wokenSeconds. Attacks: min/max range cm, windup s (telegraphed), cooldown s, damageMult x its bite, poise, plus per-move numbers. placeholder

bite._flags: impact 1-5 (poise.reactions), parryable, low (passes under a jump) per move; a blocked creature blow costs defense.creatureStaminaDamage x its damage.
bite._bite: its snap at running prey (prey can't block or dodge; at survivors it swings its bite ability)

telegraph._comment: Creature attack wind-ups, the look (WRCreature.cpp; how long each lasts is the attack's own windup: creature.biteTiming, creatureAI.<kind>). From the swing's start to its move the creature glows (M_WindupGlow over its materials: a flash for flashSeconds, then startGlow building to full; glow x opacity, wash = how much of the body fills in besides the rim; color sRGB, one for every creature) and rears back, reaching the pose by poseBy of the wind-up: pitch degrees (+ nose up on the hind feet, - head down on the front), back x its radius, sink x its half height. After the move it springs forward over releaseSeconds. Bosses glow but keep their own clips. glow 0: no glow at all (Raven 2026-11-01: the attack clips wind up on their own; the rear-back and growl stay). enabled 0 turns it all off. placeholder

look._comment: Camera look from the mouse and the pad's right stick, and held-input isolation. Settings > Look and controller multiplies the speeds (sensitivity 0.1-4) and can invert up/down; neither is inverted by default (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS 1.15).
look._pad: pad*: degrees a second at full tilt and sensitivity 1; curve > 1 makes small tilts finer. The player picks the dead zone (0.05-0.35, default 0.15) and the curve (Linear padCurveLinear / Standard padCurve / Precise padCurvePrecise) in Settings > Look and controller (cookpass-ui); padDeadZone is that page's reference value.
look._flick: Locked on, the right stick past flickThreshold moves the lock to the nearest target that way on screen; it has to fall under flickRearm before the next flick.
look._isolation: After leaving a menu, wheel, page, build placing or a mount, gameplay presses wait this long (COMBAT-AND-LESSONS L8).

pad._comment: The pad in menus (WRPadInput): the left stick moves the cursor, the D-pad jumps it to the next button, the right stick scrolls.
pad._cursor: cursorSpeed: pixels a second at full tilt on a 1080-high screen (scaled with the screen); cursorOverTarget: the speed over something clickable.

report._comment: Report a problem (F8 / View on a pad): where reports go, the picture's size, retries and the trip from a client to the host.
report._chips: chips: the quick notes under the F8 panel's note box (one press adds the line, again takes it out). crashLogLines: how many of a crashed run's last log lines go with its crash report (the main menu's crash card).

reactions._comment: Element reactions (FULL-GAME 4.2, cooks/build-combat-full.md 2.10): the last element to strike a body clings for window s; a different one landing inside it reacts and uses it up. Two players' elements meeting (or the owner of the pair) react in full, one player alone at nonOwnerScale. Fire then frost = the steam burst: damage, poise, soak and blind to everyone within radius cm. Lightning on a soaked body: + damage share and a shockChance free shock.

sun_strike._note: Sun (WRAbilitiesSun.cpp): any melee weapon; costs spells.sunStrike.radianceCost Radiance.

blazing_arc._note: Sun: a 220-degree arc 3.8 m; charged x2.0 and 5 m.

noon_strike._note: Sun: an overhead blow; a column of sunlight falls on the struck point 0.9 s later (spells.noonStrike.column).

infect_strike._note: Spore (WRAbilitiesSpore.cpp): any melee weapon; costs spells.infectStrike.sporeCost Spores; plants 3 Spores on what it hits.

wave_cut._note: Tide (WRAbilitiesTide.cpp): any melee weapon; costs spells.waveCut.flowCost Flow; works under water.

harpoon_throw._note: Tide (WRAbilitiesTide.cpp): a spear in hand, thrown on a line (AWRHarpoonLine); pressed again within reelWindow s: the reel (held holdSeconds: Anchor).

wind_cut._note: Wind (WRAbilitiesWind.cpp): costs spells.windCut.momentumCost Momentum (free in Sky lord); a blade of wind leaves the edge at the active frames (spells.windCut.wave*).

plunge._note: Wind: airborne only; dives until landing; spells.plunge has the ring, the height bonus and the dive.

whirlwind._note: Wind: 4 spins of spells.whirlwind.spinSeconds, each hitting everything within spells.whirlwind.radius; held, one more a spells.whirlwind.holdMomentum.

wind_arrow._note: Wind: through the bow or crossbow that's out; one arrow or bolt; ranged: fits are the ranged slot's kinds (UWRGA_Melee::WildbrandFits reads the ranged slot for these).

wildbrands._comment: Wildbrands (combat.md 2.12): a weapon art slotted and fired through the held weapon. fits: the classes it works with (empty: every melee class; a slot that doesn't fit greys out with the reason); windup / active / recovery s; dmg x the class's light (heavy for heavy arts) hit; stance x the class's light stance; buildup per hit; ha: hyperarmor through it; heat / chill: what it builds; stamina; charge (hold the slot: max s, dmg x at max); followUp (a second press from its combo window until window s after it: dmg, windup); mounted: usable from the saddle. Raven's spells.<art> numbers are the fallback.

charged_weapon._note: Lightning (WRAbilitiesLightning.cpp): Static strike's thrust arcs to arc.targets more (+ Arc ranks) within arc.radius at arc.share of its damage and shock, chargeGain Charge. Charged weapon needs minCharge, spends all Charge: damage x (1 + damagePerCharge x Charge share), shock shockBase + shockPerCharge x share; held, the bar gains holdChargePerSecond up to charge.max s first.

leech_strike._note: Blood (WRAbilitiesBlood.cpp): both cost HP (spells.crimsonSlash / leechStrike hpCost) on top of the stamina; Leech strike heals spells.leechStrike.heal of the damage it deals through the lifesteal pipeline (WRBloodPath.cpp).

briar_strike._note: Nature (WRAbilitiesNature.cpp): costs spells.briarStrike.growthCost Growth on top of the stamina; roots a lowland creature entangleLowland s.

runic_strike._note: Arcane (WRAbilitiesArcane.cpp): any melee weapon; costs spells.runicStrike.manaCost Mana.

grave_strike._note: Necromancy (WRAbilitiesNecro.cpp): any melee weapon; costs spells.graveStrike.soulCost Souls.

scythe_sweep._note: Necromancy (WRAbilitiesNecro.cpp): one sweep round you (arc degrees, reach cm), hyperarmor; costs spells.scytheSweep.soulCost Souls.

vine_lash._note: Nature (WRAbilitiesNature.cpp): a whip of thorned vine reach cm long (width cm each side); pressed again within followUp.window s of the lash it pulls the first body it caught pull cm to you (never a boss), free of Growth and at half the stamina.

potions._comment: The drink (CAL 1.10, combat.md 2.16): drinkSeconds committed (no cancelling), the heal lands at healAt s, walking at walkMultiplier meanwhile; one sharedCooldown s for every drink on the belt. A stagger mid-drink loses it.

mounted._comment: Fighting from the saddle (combat.md 2.19): Light swings to the side the camera faces, Heavy rears and strikes ahead (running-attack rows). A spear at couchSpeed cm/s or more: hold Heavy to couch it for couchSeconds: the first body within couchRadius of its line couchReach cm ahead takes couchDamage x the heavy, couchStance x stance, impact 5. A hit of unhorseImpact or more (or one that staggers the mount) throws the rider (unhorseKnockdown s down). The mount bites its rider's lock target every mountBiteSeconds when in reach.

wet._comment: cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.7 (world-map W1): rain on you outdoors or the water you're in makes you Wet for drySeconds after; by a warding fire you dry in fireSeconds. While wet: fire damage x fireDamage, burn buildup x burnBuildup, frostbite x frostBuildup, shock x shockBuildup. enabled 0: Wet is off until its design passes (Aaron 11-16, r-wet: 'We will do more design passes to make it really good'); 1 turns all of it back on, nothing else to change.

rest._comment: breathHz: a sleeper's breath (cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.7). Sleeping (WRSurvival, survival-crafting 2.2): E on your bed lies you down for sleepSeconds; a blow, empty hunger/thirst or moving gets you up with no Rest. Refused with a hostile after you within enemyRange cm. The pose: the hero lies on the mattress (bedTop / bedrollTop cm above the piece), poseOffset cm along the bed from its middle, turned poseYaw degrees from the bed; without a sleep clip the death clip is held from poseStart (0-1) at poseRate. The view dims to dimTo over dimSeconds.

rested._comment: Rested from a finished sleep (DD Survival; survival-crafting 2.2): bedMinutes / bedrollMinutes + perComfort per comfort point; staminaRegen and skillXp multiply, drain multiplies hunger and thirst loss. Death ends it.

comfort._comment: Comfort at a bed (Valheim rule): pieces.json comfort rows within radius cm whose top has a built roof/floor within roofHeight cm above; the best value per group counts; up to trophyMax different trophies; a Hearth within radius is a fire worth hearth; capped at cap.
comfort._offering: build-building: a cooked meal left on a new Hearth in its first offeringHours game hours adds offering to every bed in its claim; the Decorator perk adds its value and raises the cap to decoratorCap.

darkness._comment: Unlit (FULL-GAME 6.1 "darkness is dangerous; caves need light"): in a cave (chamber, or the tunnel deeper than caveMouth cm from its centre) or a weather.json darkNights biome at night / underground biome, with no light reaching you. creatures.json darkHunter creatures notice the unlit from darkHunterAggroMult x as far.

farm._comment: Farming (WRFarm.cpp; cooks/build-farming.md). seedsPerPlot: one planting. growSeconds / waterSeconds: how often plots grow / water finds its way. wateredTime: a watered crop's growing time x this (waterWiseTime with Water wise); waterRange cm from water, a well or a running channel; roofHeight: a built roof this close above shades a plot (glass doesn't); wallReach / greenhouseWalls: a greenhouse is a glass roof and this share of 16 rays at 1.2 m meeting walls within wallReach; windyAbove cm: windy crops' height; fertiliserYield, graftYield; companionRange / companionTime; hive: pollinateRange / pollinateTime, forageRange (crops it needs near), homeRange (its Hiveback), honeySeconds, waxSeconds; pen: capacity, trough, half (cm, inside the fence), breedMinutes, breedFeed, growMinutes; trap: minDepth cm, seconds, slots; saltpan: seconds, shoreRange, maxAboveSea; channel: half length, join (ends this close carry water), maxRise; paddy / kelp: depths (cm). screamStagger s. fireHeight / fireFx / fireScale: where a kitchen station's fire burns (cm above the ground) and its flames. waterMaterial / glassMaterial: what the water in a well or channel and greenhouse glass wear. biomeNames: how prompts name each land.

show._comment: cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.4: kitchens show their work on drawing machines within range cm of the camera: the food on the campfire spit turning spitTurn deg/s, browning by the job; the tray food on the hearth stone at stoneX / stoneY cm; the pot lid rattling lidLift cm at lidHz; steam / smoke fx where they leave (steamZ over the pot; smoke.<type> x / z in the station frame, cm).

sway._comment: cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.5: crops lean from their base in the wind: calm degrees at full growth, x gust (1 + storm in a thunderstorm / blizzard / gale), hz the main wave and slowHz the second, waveCm how far apart plants a gust reaches at the same moment; only plots within range cm of the camera move.

food._comment: Food (cooks/build-farming.md 2.8-2.9). staleBelow: at or under this freshness a food gives staleValue of its worth. sweepSeconds: how often the server re-stamps food whose container changed pace and turns spoiled food into Spoiled food. tundraChest: a chest's pace in the tundra (an ice box's is its pieces.json cold). goldenWorth: a dish cooked with a golden crop. mushSeconds: Grey mush's cooking time. iceBlockChance: a blow on an ice rock gives an ice block.
food._consume: cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.1-3.3. eat / drink: a food (a drink) is a committed use like a potion: seconds long (State.Drinking: no guard, roll or swing, potions.walkMultiplier walk), its worth lands at landsAt x seconds if still going, bites at bite1 / bite2 (fractions); pose: the off hand to the mouth (degrees: armForward lifts the upper arm forward, armIn across the chest, elbowBend folds the forearm; biteDip the head and hand meeting a bite; drinkTilt the head tipped back for a drink; easeSeconds in and out). warn: notices at warnBelow (re-armed rewarn above it), body sounds under bodyBelow every bodyGapMin to bodyGapMax seconds (only you hear them), the empty gauge pulses at pulseHz.

carry._comment: cooks/cookpass-survival.md 3.7: a lit torch is carried at the chest in the off hand: degrees the upper arm lifts forward (armForward) and out (armOut), the elbow bends (elbowBend); eased over easeSeconds.

lights._comment: What lights you (WRSurvival UWRLightSubsystem): radius cm (also the held light's visible reach), ward = stops corruption building, halves = halves it. Held lights by item id: kind torch (off hand, no shield) / lantern (hip); fuel = the item a lantern burns (its durability = seconds per fuel). torchTilt / lanternOut / lanternDrop place them on the body.

riftborn._comment: The Graveyard's Riftborn (Gravehound, Wraithmoth, Tombback): share % of those spawning south of fromY (cm), healthMult, curse buildup on every blow, desat / bright of the look.

crystalEvents._comment: The Resonance (WRCrystalHazards StepResonance; cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.10; scheduled by world.json events.resonance). pealEvery (s), pealSpeed (cm/s out of the Prism Hall), pealSeconds (each crystal's flare as it passes), pealGlow (the flare's glow level), glow (the lining's level all through it), shake, payout (resonant crystal x), geodeYield (resonant crystal in each singing geode), runeChance (each found rune in each geode).

fungalEvents._comment: The Sporefall (WRFungalEvents, cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.10; world.json events.sporefall schedules it). beat: the glow's 35-a-minute sync; patchEvery m (one flush patch per cell near a survivor), maxPatches, patchCloud cm; bloomAfter s in a flush cloud; bloomPoison on a bloomed bite; bloomBurst cm and its seconds; deepcapMult (the signature x3); sacMult (spore sacs double). invasion: an invader standing standSeconds leaves a markRadius cloud for markHours.

fungalLife._comment: The Fungal caverns' creatures (WRFungalCreatures, cooks/biome-fungal.md 2.12, cooks/build-biome-fungal.md 2.12). dens: denEvery s, denNear / denFar cm (a den fills when a survivor comes within denNear, empties past denFar), denRespawn s, denSecond (a second kind home). ceilingReach: how high over it a hunter finds a ceiling. Per creature: the reaches, holds, latches, puffs and the toad's leap (jumpZ cm/s, jumpHold s: Jump held charges it).

graveyardWorld._comment: The Graveyard's world (WRGraveWorld; cooks/build-biome-graveyard.md 2.3-2.9). map: the world it is built in. buildPerFrame: places spawned a frame. siteCull / kitCull / underCull (cm): how far hand sites, kit POIs and the catacombs' rooms draw (landmarks and the lantern roads always). nearLamps / nearLampRange: the light budget, the nearest road tōrō that cast real light at night within range (the rest glow by their boxes alone). holdDrift (cm): how far you may move while digging or lighting before it stops. stairGoldHours: game hours the Lantern Stair burns gold after S3. nodes.<kind>: hits, perHit and respawn (s) of the gathering (a game day is 3,600 s). anvilRefillHours / limeRefillHours / vaultRefillHours / nicheRefillHours: game hours till a cache fills again. keepsakeAt.<site>.x: how far in front of its site a keepsake lies (cm). pondMaterial: the Lantern Pond's and the cisterns' water.

sky._comment: WRSky over the Graveyard: blendSpeed; fogColor (sRGB) and fogDensity: the bruise haze; duskColor: the low sun's yellow-green rim; whiteTemp, saturation, gain: the grade; kneeTop / chestTop cm: Ground mist's and Corpse fog's layer; mistFalloff, mistDensity; bloodMoonLux (extra moon x) and bloodMoonColor.

corruption._comment: How the local survivor's Corruption reads on the Graveyard: from 50 the colour drains (drain x saturation lost by 100) and the vignette closes (vignette); from 75 whispers every whisperMin-Max s; at 100 the toro flicker.

Corruption (DD Survival; survival-crafting 2.5) builds only in weather.json biomes with a corruption row: +1 per buildNightSeconds at night / underground / in a rift, +1 per buildDaySeconds by day; falls 1 per fallSeconds elsewhere; Rest keeps restKeeps of it. steps 25/50/75/100: healingTaken, staminaRegen (+ dark-hunters treat you as unlit), maxStamina off, Marked (markedAggroMult for the biome's creatures, resourceGain). The biome's path takes no penalties and gains pathDamage per step.

weather._comment: Weather (Data/weather.json holds the biome rows). enabled 0 stops the rolls. deepSnowRun: run speed in a blizzard's deep snow in the open. sunElevation / sunYaw: where a heat wave's sun is for the shade check.

pvp._comment: Player against player (combat.md 2.20, ER patch 1.07): damage x global, then x the weapon class's pvp (Data/weapons.json), Wildbrands x wildbrand, spells x spell, a tame's bite x tameDamage; status buildup x buildup. Crits: crit.pvpBackstabArc, crit.pvpDamage, crit.riseIFrames. combatTagSeconds: hitting or being hit by a player holds you in the fight (no fast travel, no changing where you wake, no clan storage); logging out meanwhile leaves your body in the world logoutBodySeconds.

tame._comment: Taming beyond the tame (cooks/build-taming.md, WRTaming.cpp). Levels: a wild creature's level is its band's (levels.*Min..Max), each level a random point in one of six stats (health, stamina, damage, carry, speed, torpor); a stat's multiplier is 1 + statPerPoint x (points - the band's middle / 6), held to +-wildClamp unless bred. Bond: levels 1..bondMax after taming, level n costs bondBase + bondPer x n tame XP (x the server's xpMultiplier), each +bondStat to every stat and 1 skill point (Data/tame_trees.json). xp: perDamage per damage it deals (half from its saddle), kill XP by the kill's tier for tames that hit it within killWindow s, 1 per rideMetres ridden, 1 per haulMetres hauled carrying haulShare of its capacity, dig per ore dug, 1 per lightMinutes lighting its owner's dark, farm per pen product. skillXp: the owner's Taming XP per bond level, birth or hatch, answered care.
tame._hunger: A tame's hunger empties in small/medium/large Hours (by its size); under eatBelow it eats its food (or kibble) from its packs, then a pen's trough within troughRange cm, perFood each. Empty: no stamina regen, and after starveMinutes it loses starveHpPerMinute of its max health a minute. Nothing ticks without a player within activeRange cm.
tame._breed: Two tames of a kind (opposite sexes, mating on, fed, adult, yours or your clan's) within range cm fill a mating bar over mateSeconds; then she rests cooldownHours (Fertile: 1.5x faster). Egg layers (creatures.json birth egg) lay a fertilised egg; the rest carry pregnancy.<difficulty> s. Babies start at babyStart size and grow to 1 over growth.<difficulty> s (both x the server's maturationMultiplier), health and bite from babyStatsAtBirth up. Each stat comes from one parent, higherShare the one with more points; mutationRolls at mutationChance (x 1 + Breeder) add mutationPoints to a stat and a morph, a line at mutationCap can't mutate; wildMutantChance of wild spawns carry one (x2 within rareFinderRange of Rare finder). Prolific twins twinChance. A laid egg is its owner's clan's for eggClaimSeconds.

voidCreatures._comment: The Wasteland's creatures beyond their rows (WRVoidCreatures; biome-void 2.12). riftborn: share (elsewhere %), healthMult / damageMult, desat / bright (the look), curse on every blow, blinkCooldown s, essence on death. blink: behind cm (the blink kick), tell s (a Riftborn's). riftmaw: homeSearch / sense / giveUp / reach / burstFrom / outOfRift cm, attacksOut before it goes back, retreatAt health share, backIn s, landSpeed x far from a rift, catch s. hush: creepSpeed cm/s (under it you are silent: the crouch stand-in), walk / run / action / roll reach cm, litter / glass / deadCalm multipliers, risenMult, loseAfter s, touchRange cm, catch s, liftScreamAt s before release, liftStagger s. gnawer: maxLatched on one body, maxLatch s, shakenStagger s. nullwing: trailAhead cm, diveDown / wingDown s. driftmote: driftRise cm, driftSeconds, senseRange cm (a tame one pulses toward rifts). rideBlink: the ridden Voidstrider's blink. hold: throw cm/s and stagger. voidOnVoid: void damage on a void body.

voidPath._comment: The Void path's bar and costs (WRVoidPath; biome-void 2.17.1). max: the bar. decay per s after decayDelay s without a void ability. tolerance: base (Void tolerance adds). damagePerPoint: void damage x (1 + it x bar). selfLimit: your own abilities can't take MaxHealthLost past this share of max HP. emptyVessel: gain x / max HP cost x for the root passive (main path only). unravelled: the status' seconds (bosses), armour cut, stance taken. feed: max HP back per kill by tier. unseen: bosses' share. gluttonyCap: the most Gluttony adds. sacrificeTag seconds come from spells.sacrifice.

voidBosses._comment: The Wasteland arenas (WRVoidBosses): the Null Gate rises or lowers over gate.seconds; its winch is held gate.crankSeconds; voidFloor cm under the Great Rift lip is where the black takes you (Unmade).

voidHazards._comment: The Wasteland's ground hazards and the Rift Storm (WRVoidHazards; biome-void 2.8, 2.10). litter: 6 m cells over V1; a spark smoulders smoulder s, then the front walks downwind m/s along the wind (windX, windY) and upwind m/s against it, each cell burning burnSeconds (dps, burnPerSecond) and staying black regrowSeconds (2 game days); maxCells caps one fire. crust: a landing faster than landingSpeed cm/s breaks it; it skins over in regrowSeconds. storm: open seeds, waves waveEvery s apart, the rift zone cm, the heart's salt damage, ringMult on its voidglass, xp per closed rift, targetRange cm to a claim.

voidUnmade._comment: The Unmade Place and the Descent lift (WRVoidUnmade; biome-void 2.5). stairDepth m of the Choir's Descent (0.35 m steps); top cm under the lip where the pocket's drain starts; drainMult on the rift drain inside; lastNoteReach cm round U8; the rubble garden's voidglass (gardenPerHit, gardenRespawn s); reliquaryEssence; the lift: liftDrop m to U1, liftSpeed m/s, repairSeconds.

skyLife._comment: The Sky's creatures (WRSkyCreatures / WRSkyCreatureAI; cooks/biome-sky.md 2.9, build-biome-sky.md 2.11). populations: kind, the islands (or sub-zone letters) it lives on, how many (x server.creatureNumbers), mode: top (on the island), soar (a ring 15-40 m over it: the flyer rule), lip (off the edge, under it: Skyrays), float (2 m over it: Cloudbacks), column (an updraft's top: Mistlarks), roost (asleep there by day), drift (blooms across the gaps); nightOnly. moss._comment: Levistone moss (Aaron 11-16, r-moss; WRSkyMoss.cpp): beside every keel node a moss-grown lump of levistone floats outCm out from the root over open air, upCm above the node. Hold E seconds to peel it: gives levistone_moss, ripe again for you after respawnHours game hours; reachCm the hold's reach. Look: bobCm / bobHz the float's rise and fall, turnDeg its slow turn, swayDeg / swayHz the beards' swing, lookRange cm from the camera it moves within; the beard tips glow at night (glowNight, glowDay the M_CrystalGlow Rest level; lightRadius / lightNight the cyan light under it).

glide._comment: Gliding (WRSkyAir, world-map 2.5 table; UWRCharacterMovementComponent::PhysGlide). Per kind (crude_glider, levistone_glider, path = the Wind path's Path Glide, skysilk = Skysilk 4's 6 s from any jump): forward / sink cm/s, stamina a second (none in an updraft), drift x the wind, turnRate deg/s. openAbove cm of air under you to open; closeGuard s before Jump closes it again; speedEase / verticalEase; windSpeed cm/s of the Sky's wind at strength 1; featherfallStamina x with Featherfall. Durability (300 s crude, 900 s levistone) is the items' glider.durability.

fall._comment: Fall damage, game-wide (combat SPEC; WRSkyAir): measured from the highest point since you last stood (a glide, an updraft, water, a ladder or a line resets it). None under hurtFrom m; from hurtFrom to killFrom m, max health x (h - hurtFrom) / (killFrom - hurtFrom), x the gear stat fallDamage (Skysilk 2: -0.5) and x featherdownMult under the Featherdown draught; killFrom or more kills (unless that multiplier is under 1). Featherfall takes none; the Kite String artifact's own rule replaces this one while worn.

knockback._comment: Wind's hit property (combat.md 2.11, WRWind::Knock): a push of the ability's distance x the body's share by tier (survivors take it whole, through brace / anchor boots / a roll in WRSkyAir::Push; bosses never), lifted lift x its speed off the ground so it carries; driven into a wall within the push: wallSlamStance stance (+ Off balance), wallSlamDamage, wallSlamPoise.

underwater._comment: Underwater play (WRUnderwater, WRCharacterMovementComponent; cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.6, cooks/build-biome-ocean.md 2.7). Under = the head (headBelowTop cm under the capsule's top) is in water. swimSpeed / fastSwim cm/s under the surface (Sprint), gillsSpeed x with Gills; neutralBuoyancy wholly under (holds depth), riseBuoyancy while Jump (Rise) is held; Dive (Left Ctrl, or Dodge held dodgeHoldSeconds) sinks; maxSwimPitch: how steeply forward follows the camera. kickDodge: the Dodge under water (3D burst), surfaceDodge cm at the surface. Wading: water wadeFrom..140 cm over the feet runs x wadeRun, no sprint over noSprintOver. breath: base s + perSwimLevel x Swimming level, refillSeconds to full at the surface or in an air pocket, drownDps once it's out, lowFraction when the arc pulses and the heartbeat starts. crush: depth cm (5 a second below it: dps), gills cm with Gills (the helm / Reefmail's four set passDepth in gear.json; Pressure adds crushDepth, Abyss diver noCrush). Combat: thrustClasses swing at full speed, others x meleePlayRate; noChargeClasses can't charge a heavy; guardStaminaMult; crossbowRange x; boltSpeedMult for every path but Tide; fireMult (no burn at all); lightning spreads lightningSpreadRadius cm in the same water (x lightningSpreadDamage of the blow, shock lightningSpreadShock); cameraArm cm. pressureHumDepth / earPopDepth cm: the sounds.

tide._comment: The Ocean's tide (WRTide; cooks/biome-ocean.md 2.8, 2.10; cooks/build-biome-ocean.md 2.6). range cm (high to low), periodHours between highs, highHour (highs at 00:00 and 12:00, lows 06:00 / 18:00). box: the tide's box in map metres (the B2 coast between the Sky's Chain Cliffs and the Swamp's estuary, west edge on the Spine's ridge), ramp m outward north / south / east where it blends to the still sea. god._comment: The testers' god mode (WRGod, cooks/build-godmode.md): who is a tester is the Freedom35 site's word, never a number here. site: where the game asks (POST /api/pc/tester); siteTimeout s; clockSkew s a proof's iat may be ahead of the server's clock; proofsPerConnection: proofs a connection may send. tickSeconds: the server's refill of vitals. flyBase cm/s at speed x1, flySpeedMin/Max the panel's range, flyBrake cm/s2 per x1. killRadius / hitboxRange cm. spawnAhead cm in front, spawnMax per press. buildKit: of each building material. privatePresets: server presets (space-separated) where a dedicated server allows god mode (single player and hosted worlds always do; -wrtestworld marks any server private). listMax: rows a list shows before the search narrows it.
god._gate: Aaron 11-16 (r-colin, r-pubserver): god mode is entered by typing gateWord in the chat line (a verified tester only; from anyone else it's an ordinary chat line), and typed again it goes off. It works on every world now; privatePresets only decides whether the panel's banner says the world is public (what you change there marks it tested). A tester in god mode moderates any world as its host (kick, ban, admins).
